## Amendment

Changes existing terms — numbered per contract so "as amended by Amendment No. 2" resolves unambiguously. Amend Contract (`cards/legal/commands/amend-contract-command`) allocates numbers; Contract Version snapshots state at each execution.

### Non-goals

Does not rewrite the Contract card’s own fields — enacting an amendment’s commercial effect (new value, new end date) is a deliberate human edit plus re-execution, not automation.
